Pune murder case: Allegations of secret marriage emerge

Pune police are investigating the murder of businessman Ketan Agarwal, with a new angle suggesting the prime accused, Siya Goyal, may have secretly married Chetan Chaudhary four months before Agarwal's death. Digital evidence is being examined to verify this alleged marriage, which reportedly occurred after Goyal's engagement to Agarwal. Goyal's lawyer has denied the reports of a secret marriage. In a related development, the grandfather of the murder victim, Ketan Agarwal, has died of a cardiac arrest.
